Perfect Day is a precision-fermentation food-ingredient company and publishes no product/developer API; this is the one machine-readable surface it operates. Read operations on this resource were verified to respond anonymously (HTTP 200) on 2026-08-02; write operations require authentication (WordPress application passwords).
